== Summary ==
Original slip, 12 October 2004: •Vader’s Bounty (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 12 October 2004 sheet for [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set #6 revised sheet] (Players Committee, PDF dated 12 October 2004, “Revised 10/12/2004”; Virtual Set 6.pdf on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 6 April 2005), page 3, slip 48. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Vader's Bounty (V) (Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds) (Original)|Vader's Bounty (V) (Virtual Set 6)]].
